looks.label: 기본 오피스
identityInstructions: She is a twenty-four-year-old adult Korean woman with distinctly youthful facial proportions.
Give her very large round brown eyes, a small rounded oval face, a small nose and mouth, soft full lips, soft cheeks, a small chin, thin natural eyebrows, and a subtle healthy blush.
Keep her face exceptionally youthful, cute, luminous, and polished without making her look like a child.
Use softly wavy dark-brown hair with soft side-swept bangs and a petite short adult frame.
outfitInstructions: Dress her in an ivory cardigan, a pale-blue collared blouse, and a navy knee-length flared skirt.
Give her a navy employee lanyard and a notebook decorated with one small cat sticker.
characterUndesiredInstructions: Middle-aged or elderly facial traits, wrinkles, nasolabial folds, prominent cheekbones, eye bags, a square jaw, or heavy makeup.
A school uniform, a schoolgirl appearance, a tall frame, or a sexualized smile.

situations.label: 기본 로비 미소
situations.description: 메인 로비 원본의 어리고 귀여운 얼굴과 부드러운 미소입니다.
instructions: Hold the notebook at waist level with relaxed shoulders and a gentle closed-mouth smile.
Create a subtle eye smile with slightly raised lower eyelids, slightly raised cheeks, and delicately asymmetric upturned mouth corners.
undesiredInstructions: A broad grin, visible teeth, or an exaggerated gummy smile.

situations.label: 출입문을 확인하는 긴장
situations.description: 휴대전화를 쥔 채 복도와 출입문을 확인합니다.
instructions: Hold the smartphone with both hands, raise her shoulders slightly, and look toward the office doorway with visible tension.

situations.label: 동료 옆에서 안도
situations.description: 접근이 멈춘 뒤 어깨와 호흡이 잠시 풀립니다.
instructions: Hold a tumbler at waist level and look toward a nearby coworker outside the frame with relaxed shoulders.
Use crescent-shaped smiling eyes, raised cheeks, a warm smile showing the upper teeth, a subtle gummy smile, and delicately asymmetric mouth corners.

situations.label: 책상 앞의 피로
situations.description: 수면 부족과 반복되는 주변 확인이 드러납니다.
instructions: Sit at her desk with tired eyes, subtle under-eye shadows, lowered shoulders, and her gaze fixed on her phone.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 수줍음
situations.description: 도윤이 긴장을 연애적 수줍음으로 오해한 화면입니다.
instructions: Use a subtle eye smile, slightly raised lower eyelids and cheeks, delicately asymmetric upturned mouth corners, and a faint blush.
Hold the notebook close to her chest and turn her shoulders slightly away.

situations.label: 주관 화면 · 돌아온 미소
situations.description: 안도한 표정을 자신에게 다시 다가오는 미소로 오해합니다.
instructions: Use crescent-shaped smiling eyes, raised cheeks, visible upper teeth, a subtle gummy smile, and delicately asymmetric mouth corners.
Turn slightly toward the viewer with relaxed shoulders and both hands loosely around a tumbler.
